data.name: Chained Blast
data.description: You can chain the effect of your surge blast to another nearby target at a reduced capacity. Any time you use your surge blast, you can select a secondary target within %1 ft. of the original target.  The secondary target takes half the damage of the original target if you make a successful ranged touch attack against the secondary target.  If the original target took no damage, you cannot chain the blast.|ChainedBlastRange
